liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Rain** (3 reviews, 1 other source): Rain was played for the first time at this show; Rain remembered vividly as the high point of the night [1][10][13][20]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Band hit an extremely high point around the 'Wish I were a Headlight' lines [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Rain**: back after 187 archived shows (974 days) [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-12-02.140248.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 145 min; rated 3/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Opening song has another band faintly audible from a taped-over source; normal after Stranger [18]
- **gd1992-12-02.fob.schoeps.evans.gems.82302.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 18 songs; 152 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: Loud and clear and complete, but shaky at first and with too much audience noise [14]
- **gd92-12-02.aud.ststephen.12228.sbefail.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 143 min; rated 1.67/5 by 3 [7]. Said about its sound: Audience recording of weak quality; Drums are mixed far too high in this audience recording [10][15]
- **gd1992-12-02.140148.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 18 songs; 145 min [2]

## Around the show

- First show back after Jerry's illness and the cancelled fall tour [10]
- Jerry came across as moody about his day job and wanting to return to bed [11]
- Jerry was returning from near death; his face showed him trying to reconnect with his guitar [12]
- Vince had a good night, and Bralove kept keyboard sounds mostly to organic piano [18]
- Jerry was finding his footing, starting a health recovery that continued afterward [18]
- First show after six months away, following Jerry's illness; he refused hospital and was treated at home [20]
- Jerry nearly died, lost 50 pounds, and was diagnosed with organ dysfunction, heart and lung disease, and poorly managed diabetes [20]
- Security walked the aisle during the last two minutes of Let It Grow [6]
- Not especially well played, yet unforgettable to the Dead family given Jerry's second return from the brink [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-12-02.140248.sbd.cm.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [1]. Also: Two sets of masters were combined to make the show complete; files are 16 bit [1]
- **gd1992-12-02.fob.schoeps.evans.gems.82302.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Todd Evans; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: Schoeps Mk4v Cardiod Capsule (ORTF) -> Schopes Kc5 Active Cable -> Schoeps CMC3 Mic Body -> Oade Mic Pre -> Monster M1000 Jumper Cable (12" -> Panasonic sv255… [6]. Also: Some songs were patched with another source (shnid 12228) because microphones had to be hidden from security [6]
- **gd92-12-02.aud.ststephen.12228.sbefail.shnf**: taped by Unknown; source: Audience Recording [7]
- **gd1992-12-02.140148.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Sameh Tawfik Grateful Dead: [1992-12-03 McNichols Sports Arena, Denver, CO, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1992-12-03-mcnichols-sports-arena-denver-co-usa/) [22]
